_comment: eval_cases.json — atlas intent→capability eval cases (AT-2). Created 2026-07-02. Updated 2026-07-03: re-baselined against the full compiled model (237 entries: widgets, skills, connectors, senses — was the 31-entry hand seed) + the fixpoint stemmer; three cases re-pointed at genuinely better specific answers (see their note fields), the fabric stemming xfail promoted to a pass, and four new cases added covering the new kinds (widget, skill, connector, sense). Each case maps a REAL user intent to the expected top-hit atlas entry id. rank_within: 1 = expected id must be the top result (strict hit), 3 = must appear in the top 3. xfail (optional string): a known ranking miss kept on purpose — never delete a case to go green; the reason documents the weakness for the ranking-upgrade task. note (optional string): reasoning for a re-pointed expectation or measured behavior. Consumed by tests/atlas/test_eval.py.

cases.intent: build me an app to track tasks
I want a human to approve what the agent does
publish this as a website
remember this across sessions
connect my gmail
show this data as a chart
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:ripple (rank 4 in the full model). widget:chart is the better answer — the user asks for a chart, and the chart widget IS the concrete capability; ripple is the rendering engine underneath it.

cases.intent: review the agent's edit before it goes live
run this long job in the background
who are our competitors linked to
cases.note: 2026-07-03: xfail promoted — the fixpoint stemmer now maps 'competitors'→'competitor' and 'linked'→'link', so fabric ranks 1. Kept rank_within 3 as originally authored; the strict-hit baseline locks the rank-1 gain.

cases.intent: let the AI write the code and I just review diffs
give my agent a personality that persists
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: soul had slipped to rank 2 behind surface:agents — 'persists' stems to 'persist' which missed the 'persistent' keyword. Fixed as a vocabulary gap: added 'persist' to the authored soul keywords.

cases.intent: sync my google calendar into the workspace
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:connector (now rank 2). The compiled model carries per-connector entries and connector:gcalendar is the better answer for a google-calendar-specific intent than the generic connector primitive.

cases.intent: roll back the site to the previous version
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: branch had slipped to rank 2 behind the site skills — the authored keyword was 'rollback' (one word) while users say 'roll back'. Fixed as a vocabulary gap: added 'roll back' to the authored branch keywords.

cases.intent: make a landing page for my bakery
import all these records every night on a schedule
map our customers and their relationships as a graph
fix this bug in the code and propose the change
build a kanban board for my team
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:pocket (now rank 2). widget:kanban is the better answer — the user names the exact widget; the pocket is the container it lands in.
